E1.excerpt: Here we investigate the nature and evolution of the active cobalt sites along with charge- and mass-transfer processes

E3.excerpt: Computational hydrogen electrode (CHE) calculations were undertaken to gain insights into the mechanism of the [Co-Pb]Ox-catalysed OER

E4.excerpt: All simulations were done on four-layer slabs of (110) terminated of β-PbO2 with half of the coordinatively unsaturated Pb sites on the surface substituted with Co.

E5.where: SI1.pdf p. 30, Supplementary Note 5 / Fig. 24 caption
E5.excerpt: The computed free energy profiles (at U = 0 V vs. SHE) associated with the OER occurring via the AEM on the Pb(Co)O2 (110) surface are shown

E6.excerpt: This precedes the potential determining step of the O-O bond formation over this Co4.00 site, with the thermodynamically limiting potential of ca 1.49 V vs. SHE.

note: Model: half-ML Co-substituted β-PbO2(110), ½ ML μ3-OH multi-site AEM; β-PbO2 is rutile type, P42/mnm.
